blind_spots_patched: Baseline chapters focused solely on ₹2,759 Cr gross borrowings and missed the +₹1,590 Cr surge in Other Liabilities, ₹926.80 Cr of TAO Digital contingent earnout obligations, CRISIL's <0.50x medium-term gearing threshold, and FY26 aborted-M&A / goodwill impairment charges.

Baseline chapters highlighted +240.8% YoY Semiconductor revenue growth and DLM's 26.5% revenue growth without quantifying Semiconductor R&D EBIT burn, foundry/memory supply bottlenecks, standalone FX losses, or DLM upfront investment margin drag.

Baseline Ch 5 treated leadership as stabilized after Feb 2025 and omitted H2 CY26 C-suite turnover as well as subsidiary preference-share governance rights attached to external Cyient Semiconductors financings.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Cyient Semiconductors' +240.8% YoY revenue surge to ₹184.7 Cr in Q2 FY27 and custom-ASIC/Kinetic momentum validates the semiconductor pivot as an unalloyed high-margin IP growth engine.
WEAKENED: Cyient's September 2026 balance-sheet leverage reset is fully captured by ₹2,759 Cr of gross borrowings (0.54x equity) and ₹6,021 Cr of Fixed Assets.
CONFIRMED: Cyient DET's Q2 FY27 operational turnaround (14.2% EBIT margin, ₹237 Cr EBIT) and Cyient DLM's 1.6x+ book-to-bill momentum remain intact.
WEAKENED: Senior leadership stabilized following Sukamal Banerjee's February 2025 appointment as DET CEO.
